description: How to deploy HTML pages into GoHighLevel (Go High Level) or Convert and Flow using API-first routing and reusable Playwright recipes for captured UI work. The OpenClaw Chrome extension handles browser recovery, followed by agent-browser (Vercel Labs, Skill 03) and enabled computer use. Reuse the existing Firebase token bridge to start a session already logged-in, navigate the funnel/website page builder, paste code, save, preview, and publish-with-approval, all without the human touching the builder.
